First time using Synthesia, do this simple flow: start with a template, edit the script, then generate and publish. 
Start a new video
• Pick Start with a template (fastest for beginners).
• Hover a template to Preview, then Use template.
Edit your video
• Replace the text with your own script (keep it simple for your first try).
Generate your video
• Open the project and click Generate (top right). 
• Add a title and description, optionally turn on burned in captions, then click Generate again.
If you want the most guided first-time experience, join our weekly “Synthesia 101: Getting Started” live session.
